label: Margherita di Francesco di Jacopo di Guglielmo
roles: wife of ser Piero da Vinci
summary: Third wife of ser Piero, married 1475; mother of his first legitimate children.

value.text: Third wife of ser Piero, married 1475; mother of his first legitimate children.

claims.statement: Margherita, daughter of Francesco di Jacopo di Guglielmo, married ser Piero in 1475 (the Sepoltuario gives 25 May 1475) and bore his first legitimate children, including Antonio (1476) and Giuliano. She died about 1485. Her patronymic is given in different forms in secondary works.
